# Mutation status for CDH1, PIK3CA, ERBB2, and ERBB3 in the 10 ER+ pILC samples with OGM data.
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Mutation status for CDH1, PIK3CA, ERBB2, ERBB3
# in 10 ER+ pILC samples with Bionano/OGM data
# Source: combined Tier 1 common MAF
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(readr)
})

# -------------------------
# Input
# -------------------------
maf_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/Compare_TumorOnly_vs_WithPON/maftools/Tier_1_common/Combined_MAF/Tier_1_common_all_samples.combined.maf"

out_dir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/Grant/WES"

# -------------------------
# 10 ER+ pILC samples with Bionano/OGM
# -------------------------
samples_10_erpos_bionano <- c(
  "TP05-232",
  "TP05-726",
  "TP07-626",
  "TP08-2202",
  "TP11-1516",
  "TP11-1780",
  "TP12-880",
  "TP13-820",
  "TP14-385",
  "TP15-M509"
)

# Genes requested
genes_of_interest <- c("CDH1", "PIK3CA", "ERBB2", "ERBB3")

# -------------------------
# Read MAF
# -------------------------
maf <- fread(
  maf_file,
  data.table = FALSE,
  sep = "\t",
  quote = "",
  fill = TRUE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

cat("\nMAF dimensions:\n")
print(dim(maf))

cat("\nMAF columns:\n")
print(colnames(maf))

# -------------------------
# Check required columns
# -------------------------
required_cols <- c(
  "Tumor_Sample_Barcode",
  "Hugo_Symbol",
  "Variant_Classification"
)

missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, colnames(maf))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(paste("Missing required MAF columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))
}

# -------------------------
# Harmonize sample IDs
# Handles MAF names like TP05-232_T
# -------------------------
maf2 <- maf %>%
  mutate(
    Tumor_Sample_Barcode = trimws(as.character(Tumor_Sample_Barcode)),
    Sample_clean = Tumor_Sample_Barcode %>%
      str_remove("_T$") %>%
      str_remove("_Tumor$") %>%
      str_remove("-T$"),
    Hugo_Symbol = trimws(as.character(Hugo_Symbol)),
    Variant_Classification = trimws(as.character(Variant_Classification))
  )

cat("\nSamples in MAF after cleaning:\n")
print(sort(unique(maf2$Sample_clean)))

cat("\nChecking 10 ER+ Bionano samples against MAF:\n")
sample_check <- tibble(
  Sample = samples_10_erpos_bionano,
  present_in_maf = Sample %in% unique(maf2$Sample_clean)
)

print(sample_check)

# -------------------------
# Non-silent / protein-altering mutation classes
# -------------------------
nonsilent_classes <- c(
  "Missense_Mutation",
  "Nonsense_Mutation",
  "Frame_Shift_Del",
  "Frame_Shift_Ins",
  "In_Frame_Del",
  "In_Frame_Ins",
  "Splice_Site",
  "Translation_Start_Site",
  "Nonstop_Mutation",
  "Start_Codon_Del",
  "Start_Codon_Ins",
  "Stop_Codon_Del",
  "Stop_Codon_Ins"
)

# -------------------------
# Filter to samples + genes
# -------------------------
maf_sub <- maf2 %>%
  filter(
    Sample_clean %in% samples_10_erpos_bionano,
    Hugo_Symbol %in% genes_of_interest,
    Variant_Classification %in% nonsilent_classes
  )

cat("\nDetected non-silent mutations in requested genes:\n")
print(
  maf_sub %>%
    select(
      Sample_clean,
      Tumor_Sample_Barcode,
      Hugo_Symbol,
      Variant_Classification,
      everything()
    )
)

# -------------------------
# Pick useful annotation columns if available
# -------------------------
candidate_annot_cols <- c(
  "HGVSp_Short",
  "HGVSp",
  "Protein_Change",
  "HGVSc",
  "Variant_Classification",
  "Variant_Type",
  "Chromosome",
  "Start_Position",
  "Reference_Allele",
  "Tumor_Seq_Allele2",
  "t_depth",
  "t_alt_count",
  "t_ref_count",
  "all_effects",
  "ONCOGENIC",
  "MUTATION_EFFECT",
  "oncogenic",
  "mutation_effect"
)

annot_cols <- intersect(candidate_annot_cols, colnames(maf_sub))

# -------------------------
# Detailed long table
# -------------------------
mutation_long <- maf_sub %>%
  select(
    Sample = Sample_clean,
    Gene = Hugo_Symbol,
    all_of(annot_cols)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Sample, Gene)

# -------------------------
# Summarize variant labels per Sample/Gene
# -------------------------
# -------------------------
# Make sure protein annotation columns exist
# This prevents errors if Protein_Change or HGVSp_Short is absent
# -------------------------

for (col in c("HGVSp_Short", "HGVSp", "Protein_Change")) {
  if (!col %in% colnames(maf_sub)) {
    maf_sub[[col]] <- NA_character_
  }
}

# -------------------------
# Summarize variant labels per Sample/Gene
# -------------------------

variant_summary <- maf_sub %>%
  mutate(
    HGVSp_Short = as.character(HGVSp_Short),
    HGVSp = as.character(HGVSp),
    Protein_Change = as.character(Protein_Change),

    protein_label = case_when(
      !is.na(HGVSp_Short) & HGVSp_Short != "" ~ HGVSp_Short,
      !is.na(HGVSp) & HGVSp != "" ~ HGVSp,
      !is.na(Protein_Change) & Protein_Change != "" ~ Protein_Change,
      TRUE ~ Variant_Classification
    ),

    variant_label = paste0(protein_label, " [", Variant_Classification, "]")
  ) %>%
  group_by(Sample = Sample_clean, Gene = Hugo_Symbol) %>%
  summarise(
    mutation_status = paste(unique(variant_label), collapse = "; "),
    n_mutations = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# -------------------------
# Make complete wide status table
# -------------------------
status_table <- expand_grid(
  Sample = samples_10_erpos_bionano,
  Gene = genes_of_interest
) %>%
  left_join(variant_summary, by = c("Sample", "Gene")) %>%
  mutate(
    mutation_status = ifelse(
      is.na(mutation_status),
      "No non-silent mutation detected in this MAF",
      mutation_status
    ),
    n_mutations = replace_na(n_mutations, 0)
  ) %>%
  select(Sample, Gene, mutation_status, n_mutations) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Gene,
    values_from = mutation_status
  )

# -------------------------
# Add WES availability note
# Based on current cohort summary:
# WES is missing for TP11-1516 and TP14-385
# -------------------------
wes_available <- tibble(
  Sample = samples_10_erpos_bionano,
  WES_available = ifelse(
    Sample %in% c("TP11-1516", "TP14-385"),
    "No",
    "Yes"
  )
)

status_table <- wes_available %>%
  left_join(status_table, by = "Sample")

cat("\n========== Final mutation status table ==========\n")
print(status_table)

# -------------------------
# Gene-level mutation counts
# Count only among WES-available samples
# -------------------------
gene_counts <- expand_grid(
  Sample = samples_10_erpos_bionano,
  Gene = genes_of_interest
) %>%
  left_join(
    variant_summary %>% mutate(mutated = TRUE),
    by = c("Sample", "Gene")
  ) %>%
  left_join(wes_available, by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(
    mutated = replace_na(mutated, FALSE)
  ) %>%
  filter(WES_available == "Yes") %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  summarise(
    mutated_samples = sum(mutated),
    total_wes_available_samples = n(),
    mutation_frequency_percent = round(100 * mutated_samples / total_wes_available_samples, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mutated_samples), Gene)

cat("\n========== Gene-level mutation counts among WES-available samples ==========\n")
print(gene_counts)

# -------------------------
# Save outputs
# -------------------------
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

status_file <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  "ERpos_Bionano_n10_CDH1_PIK3CA_ERBB2_ERBB3_mutation_status.tsv"
)

long_file <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  "ERpos_Bionano_n10_CDH1_PIK3CA_ERBB2_ERBB3_mutation_details_long.tsv"
)

counts_file <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  "ERpos_Bionano_n10_CDH1_PIK3CA_ERBB2_ERBB3_gene_counts.tsv"
)

write_tsv(status_table, status_file)
write_tsv(mutation_long, long_file)
write_tsv(gene_counts, counts_file)

cat("\nSaved files:\n")
cat(status_file, "\n")
cat(long_file, "\n")
cat(counts_file, "\n")
```
